chunks: From him, from Muhammad, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the two rakʿahs of the obligatory tawaf. He said: Do not delay them for even an hour; when you have performed tawaf, then perform salat (prayer).

key_terms.سَاعَةً: even for a period of time; here, an hour

ai.seo_question: When should the two rakʿahs of obligatory tawaf be performed?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling regarding the two rakʿahs of the obligatory tawaf. Imam Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام instructs that they should not be delayed, and that salat (prayer) should be performed immediately after completing the tawaf.
